errorMessage:
A stocked product has a negative retail price.
SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.retail_price
FROM `tv_thelook.products` AS p
JOIN `tv_thelook.inventory_items` AS i ON i.product_id = p.id
WHERE i.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05 00:00:00+00'
  AND i.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-06 00:00:00+00'
  AND p.retail_price < 0
ORDER BY p.id, p.retail_price
LIMIT 100
